title: Fully funded opportunities for artists and writers in Nigeria and Africa
seoTitle: Fully funded opportunities for Nigerian and African artists
description: Funded residencies, grants and prizes for artists and writers living in Nigeria and West Africa: how to check eligibility and what “fully funded” leaves out.
summary: For artists and writers in Nigeria and West Africa: how to check eligibility, read “fully funded” and choose which calls to enter or watch.
primaryKeyword: fully funded opportunities for artists in Nigeria
answer: If you live in Nigeria, you can find funded residencies, grants and prizes from Nigerian organizations and from international calls whose rules include you. Check who can apply, what the funding covers and when it's paid. “International” doesn't always include Nigeria, and a fully funded residency can still leave the visa and insurance to you.
keyPoints: Check citizenship, where you live and where you work; a call can restrict each.
Fully funded can still leave the visa, insurance and some travel costs to you.
The G.A.S., RESONANCE, Prince Claus and Caine cycles cited here are closed; watch for the next.
